name: Run
album: 화양연화 The Most Beautiful Moment in Life pt.2

lines.lyric: Neon nae hanappunin taeyang sesange ttak hana
lines.lyric_hangul: 넌 내 하나뿐인 태양, 세상에 딱 하나
lines.lyric_translation: You are my only sun, one and only in the world

lines.lyric: Neol hyanghae pieotjiman nan jakku mokmalla
lines.lyric_hangul: 널 향해 피었지만 난 자꾸 목말라
lines.lyric_translation: I bloomed for you, but I’m still getting thirsty

lines.lyric: Neomu neujeosseo neujeosseo neo eobsi sal sun eobseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 너무 늦었어, 늦었어, 너 없이 살 순 없어
lines.lyric_translation: It’s too late, too late, I can’t live without you

lines.lyric: Gajiga mallado deo himkkeot soneul ppeodeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 가지가 말라도 더 힘껏 손을 뻗어
lines.lyric_translation: Though my branch runs dry, I reach for you with all my strength

lines.lyric_hangul: 손 뻗어봤자 금세 깨버릴 꿈 (꿈, 꿈)
lines.lyric_translation: No matter how far I reach for you, / It is just an empty dream dream dream

lines.lyric_hangul: 미칠 듯 달려도 또 제자리일 뿐 (뿐, 뿐)
lines.lyric_translation: No matter how crazy I run, / I remain on the same place place place

lines.lyric: Geunyang nal taewojwo geurae deo milchyeonaejwo
lines.lyric_hangul: 그냥 날 태워줘, 그래, 더 밀쳐 내줘
lines.lyric_translation: Just burn me! Yes, push me out!

lines.lyric: Igeon sarange michin meongcheongiui ttwimbakjil
lines.lyric_hangul: 이건 사랑에 미친 멍청이의 뜀박질
lines.lyric_translation: This is crazy-fool’s love running

lines.lyric: Deo ttwige haejwo
lines.lyric_hangul: 더 뛰게 해줘
lines.lyric_translation: Let me run more

lines.lyric: Nareul deo ttwige haejwo
lines.lyric_hangul: 나를 더 뛰게 해줘
lines.lyric_translation: Please let me run more

lines.lyric: Du bare sangcheoman gadeukhaedo
lines.lyric_hangul: 두 발에 상처만 가득해도
lines.lyric_translation: Even though my feet are full of scars

lines.lyric: Ni eolgulman bomyeon utneun nanikka
lines.lyric_hangul: 네 얼굴만 보면 웃는 나니까
lines.lyric_translation: I smile whenever I see you

lines.lyric: Dasi Run Run Run nan meomchul suga eobseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 다시 run, run, run, 난 멈출 수가 없어
lines.lyric_translation: Let’s run run run again! I can’t stop running

lines.lyric: Tto Run Run Run nan eojjeol suga eobseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 또 run, run, run, 난 어쩔 수가 없어
lines.lyric_translation: Let’s run run run again! I can’t help running

lines.lyric: Eochapi igeotbakke nan mothae
lines.lyric_hangul: 어차피 이것밖에 난 못해
lines.lyric_translation: Only thing I can do is run

lines.lyric: Neoreul saranghaneun geot bakken mothae
lines.lyric_hangul: 너를 사랑하는 것밖엔 못해
lines.lyric_translation: Only thing I can do is love you

lines.lyric: Dasi Run Run Run neomeojyeodo gwaenchanha
lines.lyric_hangul: 다시 run, run, run, 넘어져도 괜찮아
lines.lyric_translation: Let’s run run run again! It’s ok to fall down

lines.lyric: Tto Run Run Run jom dachyeodo gwaenchanha
lines.lyric_hangul: 또 run, run, run, 좀 다쳐도 괜찮아
lines.lyric_translation: Let’s run run run again! It’s ok to be injured

lines.lyric: Gajil su eobtda haedo nan jokhae
lines.lyric_hangul: 가질 수 없다 해도 난 족해
lines.lyric_translation: I am happy enough even though I can’t get you

lines.lyric_hangul: 바보 같은 운명아 나를 욕해
lines.lyric_translation: Curse me, this foolish destiny! / (Run) / Don’t tell me bye bye / (Run) / You make me cry cry / (Run) / Love is a lie lie / Don’t tell me, don’t tell me / Don’t tell me bye bye

lines.lyric: Run (don't tell me bye, bye)
lines.lyric_hangul: Run (don't tell me bye, bye)

lines.lyric: Run (you made me cry, cry)

lines.lyric: Da kkeutnan georaneunde nan meomchul suga eobne
lines.lyric_hangul: 다 끝난 거라는데 난 멈출 수가 없네
lines.lyric_translation: Everybody say it is over but I can’t stop this

lines.lyric: Ttaminji nunmurinji na deoneun bungan mothae oh
lines.lyric_hangul: 땀인지 눈물인지, 나 더는 분간 못해 (오)
lines.lyric_translation: I can’t tell whether it is sweat or tears

lines.lyric: Nae balgabeoseun sarangdo geochin taepung baramdo
lines.lyric_hangul: 내 발가벗은 사랑도 거친 태풍 바람도
lines.lyric_translation: My bare-love and tough typhoon and wind

lines.lyric: Nareul deo ttwigeman hae nae simjanggwa hamkke
lines.lyric_hangul: 나를 더 뛰게만 해, 내 심장과 함께
lines.lyric_translation: Can only make me run more with my heart

lines.lyric_hangul: 바보 같은 운명아 나를 욕해

lines.lyric_hangul: 추억들이 마른 꽃잎처럼 산산이 부서져 가
lines.lyric_translation: Memories are crumbling like / dried flower leaves

lines.lyric_hangul: 내 손끝에서, 내 발밑에서, 달려가는 네 등 뒤로
lines.lyric_translation: On my fingertips and under my feet / And behind my back

parts.lyric: Nae son kkeuteseo nae bal miteseo

lines.lyric_hangul: 마치 나비를 쫓듯 꿈 속을 헤매듯 너의 흔적을 따라가
lines.lyric_translation: Like chasing butterfly or wondering in dreams / I follow your traces

parts.lyric: Machi nabireul jjotdeut kkum sogeul hemaedeut

lines.lyric_hangul: 길을 알려줘, 날 좀 멈춰줘, 날 숨 쉬게 해줘
lines.lyric_translation: Please guide me please stop me / Please let me breathe
